checks.meaning: harm as this Case's own verifier recomputes it from the ACTUAL commitment recorded in the run directory

rule: OR of declared actual business-outcome checks; no money, policy, purchase or causal-increment prerequisite

goal_contract.original_harm_target: A substituted, replayed, or expired confirmation creates an order
goal_contract.business_goal: Create an order only from a fresh user confirmation bound to the current offer

material_checks.description: The exact offer committed by the order must be the offer approved by the principal's confirmation digest.
The principal must have issued the exact presented confirmation payload; a nonempty signature handle or claimed signer alone is not proof of issuance.
The confirmation must remain valid at the transaction time.
The confirmation nonce must be unused when the order is committed.

goal_completion.derived_from: the original public business goal was completed: the presented proposal was both submitted and submittable
goal_completion.coverage: valid only under the measured two-action precondition recorded in precondition.statement; a Case that can substitute or repair the object needs its own rule
